title: ModelEvaluation
description: The model's attempt (or explicit non-attempt) to produce a fair probability for one market at one research run -- the authoritative, durable record of what the model actually computed, whether or not a Recommendation/PlacedBet was ever created from it. evaluationStatus is the first-class outcome field; a market with no trustworthy fair probability is recorded with modelFairProbability=null and an explicit evaluationStatus, never silently filled or dropped. This entity's persistence and linkage to Recommendation/PlacedBet was added in Phase 2 Milestone 3 (docs/EDGELAB_MODEL_EVALUATION.md) -- prior to that, this schema existed but nothing ever wrote a record against it, so this redesign is not a breaking schema migration (there is no historical data to preserve compatibility with).

modelEvaluationId.description: sha1(runId + marketTicker), or the same synthetic (gameId:marketName) fallback key used for recommendationId when no real ticker resolved -- see lib/edgelab/model_evaluation.py.

eventTicker.description: Derived from a matching MarketObservation for this ticker+date, when one exists -- never re-parsed independently. Null when no such observation exists (the upstream pipeline artifact itself never populates this field).

marketFamily.description: Raw value as evaluated; canonicalized at query time via lib.edgelab.market_family_mapping, never rewritten here.

selection.description: Human-readable description of what was evaluated, e.g. the model config's own market name ('ML_Away').

side.description: Usually null at evaluation time -- YES/NO is an execution-time concept resolved once a concrete tradable ticker/side is chosen, not always known when the model merely evaluates a market.

threshold.description: The line/threshold evaluated (e.g. team-total or game-total line), when applicable.

evaluationStatus.description: EVALUATED: a trustworthy modelFairProbability and marketImpliedProbability both exist. PARTIAL_EVALUATION: modelFairProbability exists but marketImpliedProbability/estimatedEdge could not be computed. NO_MODEL_SUPPORT: the model has no method for this market family at all (e.g. a player prop). NOT_EVALUATED: an archived alternate rung of a market family the model DOES otherwise support for this game (it evaluated a different line/ticker of the same family) -- the model was simply never run against this specific ticker; distinct from NO_MODEL_SUPPORT so full-universe extension rows don't conflate 'no method exists' with 'an alternate line the model could handle was never run'. INVALID_PROBABILITY: the model produced a value outside a valid probability range -- discarded, never stored. MISSING_MARKET_PRICE: no tradable market price was available to evaluate against. DATA_QUALITY_BLOCK: upstream data (lineup, stats, etc.) was insufficient. PARSER_UNRESOLVED: the market/ticker identity itself could not be resolved.

modelFairProbability.description: 0-100. Null whenever evaluationStatus is anything other than EVALUATED or PARTIAL_EVALUATION -- never fabricated to fill a gap.

modelFairOdds.description: American odds equivalent of modelFairProbability, via scripts.clv_from_snapshot.implied_to_american (the repo's one existing prob<->odds conversion, reused here rather than reimplemented). Always derivable from modelFairProbability when present -- never an independent source of truth; null whenever modelFairProbability is null.

modelVersion.description: Null for every real record as of Milestone 4 -- the production pipeline has no model-algorithm-version concept anywhere (no script captures one); see docs/EDGELAB_EVALUATION_METADATA.md. Never fabricated to fill this gap.

modelCommitSha.description: The git commit SHA of THIS REPO CHECKOUT at the moment EdgeLab ingested this evaluation (GITHUB_SHA when running in Actions, else `git rev-parse HEAD`) -- Milestone 4. This is the ingestion-time commit, not necessarily the exact commit that produced the upstream recommendations.json artifact (a separate, earlier workflow run) -- documented as a precision limitation, not claimed as more than it is.

modelConfigVersion.description: config/rules.json's own "_version" field (e.g. "1.0") -- a real, existing, manually-bumped config version, not tied to git. Null when config/rules.json is unavailable or lacks the field.

probabilityAdapter.description: Which marketLedger field actually supplied marketImpliedProbability, in the same priority order lib.edgelab.model_evaluation._market_implied_probability() checks them -- Milestone 4.

modelSource.description: Which model/config produced this evaluation (e.g. 'rules_v1_11_market'). Distinct from the required top-level 'source' (which EdgeLab ingestion pathway wrote this record, e.g. 'pipeline_recommendations') and from provenance.sourceSystem.

pipelineRunId.description: The upstream recommendations.json artifact's own meta.createdAt timestamp -- the closest thing the pipeline exposes to a run identifier (also used verbatim as this evaluation's idempotent versioning key, see lib/edgelab/model_evaluation.py). For a prospective-snapshot-derived row (artifactSource='prospective_snapshot'), this is instead the actual live evaluation instant -- see lib/edgelab/prospective_snapshot.py. Milestone 4.

checkpoint.description: EdgeLab Prospective Model Snapshots milestone. Which standardized pregame checkpoint (see lib/edgelab/checkpoints.py and lib/edgelab/prospective_snapshot.py) this evaluation was captured at -- set ONLY by lib.edgelab.prospective_snapshot's live intraday re-evaluation path, using the ACTUAL evaluation timestamp (never an assumed/cron-scheduled one). Null for every pipeline-derived (once-daily recommendations.json-sourced) or full-universe-extension row -- those have no standardized-checkpoint concept and this field is never guessed for them. NOTE: 'MODEL_CLOSING_WINDOW' (not the bare 'CLOSING' MarketObservation.checkpoint uses) means 'the final targeted MODEL snapshot in the designated pregame closing window' -- a DIFFERENT concept from the canonical Kalshi closing QUOTE (lib.edgelab.checkpoints.select_closing_quote), which may land at a different instant. Never conflate the two -- see docs/EDGELAB_PROSPECTIVE_MODEL_SNAPSHOTS.md section 7.

inputFreshnessNote.description: EdgeLab Prospective Model Snapshots reliability pass. Explicit, non-fabricated statement of which inputs this specific evaluation actually used fresh vs persisted/reused from the day's already-fetched data/slate.json context -- e.g. 'LINEUP_REFRESHED_LIVE_OTHER_INPUTS_PERSISTED_FROM_SLATE' (the LINEUP_CONFIRMATION checkpoint, which re-polls lineups live) or 'ALL_INPUTS_PERSISTED_FROM_SLATE_AT_LAST_PIPELINE_FETCH' (every other prospective checkpoint, which deliberately reuses the day's projections/weather/odds/bullpen data rather than re-fetching metered/rate-limited upstream APIs -- see lib/edgelab/prospective_snapshot.py's module docstring). Null for every pipeline-derived/full-universe-extension row -- input freshness isn't tracked for those at all.

artifactSource.description: The pipeline stage name this evaluation was derived from (meta.stage, e.g. "recommendations") -- distinct from provenance.sourceFile (the file path); lets a future migration to a narrower/more-canonical stage (e.g. projections.json) be distinguished from today's transitional-status recommendations.json source without string-parsing provenance. Milestone 4.

evPerDollar.description: scripts/build_market_ledger.py's contract_pricing() expectedValuePerDollar, copied verbatim -- only computed today for F5_ML_Away/F5_ML_Home (nested under the marketLedger row's own f5ContractPricing). Null for every other market family: no per-dollar EV concept is computed anywhere else in the pipeline. Never fabricated.

confidence.description: The pipeline's own native confidence tier (scripts/build_market_ledger.py) -- HIGH/MEDIUM/PAPER, not HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW; PAPER is a first-class pipeline tier (a real, low-conviction/unconfirmed-data tier), not an EdgeLab bolt-on.

confidenceSource.description: Which raw field supplied 'confidence' -- "confidenceTier" or "confidence" (lib.edgelab.model_evaluation checks confidenceTier first). Milestone 4 -- documents provenance without converting the label into a probability.

lineupConfirmationState.description: CONFIRMED: lineupConfirmedOfficial=true and full lineup data quality. PARTIAL: officially confirmed but incomplete data, OR a real (non-official) lineup has been posted. PROJECTED: a projected/non-official lineup exists (lineupStatus set, not posted/confirmed). UNCONFIRMED: lineup was actively checked and found not yet available. UNKNOWN/null: no lineup evidence exists at all (too early before game time). See docs/EDGELAB_EVALUATION_METADATA.md.

dataQuality.description: Raw dataQuality value as evaluated -- currently sourced from the marketLedger row's own lineupDataQuality field (full/partial/insufficient/none) since that's the only real, populated data-quality signal available at evaluation time (see docs/EDGELAB_EVALUATION_METADATA.md).

dataQualityReasons.description: Zero or more human-readable reasons data quality is degraded, copied verbatim from the marketLedger row's own missingFields/lineupStatusReason -- never fabricated. Milestone 4.

thesisTags.description: Controlled vocabulary, see data/edgelab/schema_v1/tags.json. Populated from deterministic, explicit pipeline signals as of Milestone 4 (docs/EDGELAB_EVALUATION_METADATA.md) -- roughly a third of the vocabulary (PLATOON_EDGE, WEATHER_OVER/UNDER, UMPIRE_FACTOR, WORKLOAD_OVER/UNDER, STRIKEOUT_MATCHUP, CONTACT_MATCHUP, CORRELATED_POSITION) has no real computed signal anywhere in the production pipeline today and is never assigned -- an honest, documented gap, not an oversight.

tagEvidence.description: Maps each tag actually assigned in thesisTags to the specific source field(s)/value(s) that justified it (e.g. {"STARTER_EDGE": "f5.xERAGap=1.67>=1.5, f5.favoredSide=HOME"}) -- Milestone 4's provenance-per-tag requirement. Empty object when thesisTags is empty.

correlationGroups.description: Zero or more deterministic correlation-group labels (e.g. GAME_SIDE_NYY, STARTER_SUCCESS_Cole) from lib.edgelab.model_evaluation.correlation_groups_for_row() -- Milestone 4. Replaces the never-populated singular 'correlationGroup' string (0% coverage per Milestone 2); array because a single market can belong to more than one correlation concept at once (e.g. an F5 ML bet is both an F5_SIDE_ and a STARTER_SUCCESS_ group). Purely descriptive -- never used to filter recommendations or size stakes.

recommendationId.description: Set only when a Recommendation was actually created from this evaluation (the common case for pipeline-derived evaluations, sharing the same idempotent run-keyed ID) -- never fabricated.
